dct_description_sm: This database covers four river confluences: the confluence of the Sainte-Anne (STA) and Bras-du-Nord (BDN) rivers, and three confluences along the Chaudière (CH) river with its Du Loup (DL), Famine (FA), and Bras-Saint-Victor (BSV) tributaries. It includes water level (pressure) measurements, water and air temperatures, ice cover observations (state and concentration), camera images for ice boom monitoring, as well as precipitation, wind speed, atmospheric pressure, measured and calculated discharge, water surface elevation data, and freeze/thaw degree-day indices (CDDF, CDDT, CDDW). The data span four consecutive winters (approximately October to May, from 2020-2021 to 2023-2024), at an hourly time step.
dct_title_s: Winter Hydrometric and Ice Cover Monitoring Dataset for River Confluences on the Chaudière and Sainte-Anne Rivers, Québec, Canada (2020–2024)
